business_problem: Takenaka needed to raise productivity and work efficiency in construction despite labor shortages, overtime limits, and fragmented construction-site data, so it could digitize operations and use business data more effectively.
solution_summary: Takenaka built a digital construction solution on AWS as the foundation of its broader business transformation and to address low productivity, skilled-labor shortages, and stricter overtime limits in construction. The platform combines data collection, AI, BI, and IoT functions so internal teams can rapidly create applications that digitize work across construction sites and corporate operations. Construction data is collected into Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS, integrated with AWS Glue and Amazon Redshift, streamed through Amazon Kinesis for timely processing, and applied to AI and digital-twin use cases with Amazon SageMaker and AWS IoT TwinMaker. This shared data and application layer lets Takenaka develop more than 100 AWS-based applications, support advanced use of construction business data, and accelerate digital-solution delivery across the company.
